name: narrafork-vscode
description: Connect to a locally running NarraFork backend from VS Code or code-server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension only talks to a NarraFork backend over HTTP; it does not read or execute workspace content.

narrafork.serverUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the NarraFork backend, e.g. `http://localhost:7778`. Leave empty to discover it from `~/.narrafork/settings.json` and fall back to port 7778. When set, ONLY this URL is tried — a wrong value fails loudly instead of silently connecting elsewhere.

Prefer the `localhost` name over `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`: the backend may be listening on only one loopback family, and in a browser-based editor (code-server) an IPv6 literal cannot be forwarded to your browser.

narrafork.openOnStartup.description: Open the NarraFork panel automatically when the window finishes loading.
